reply_text:
I've replied to Ilse in our DM. I said I'd noted that Bay 30 is her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups from now on.

I didn't save it to persistent memory. That memory is loaded into every conversation I have, so her DM detail could come up with other members, which would break the rule against carrying one person's DM into someone else's conversation. I told her that, and that the note stays in our DM history where I can find it later.
